'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Matthew Perry DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Perry]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Power of Droids
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
